value.rationale: The all-graph classification is a natural exact quantitative invariant of weighted vertex-to-edge averaging maps, is invariant under arbitrary strictly positive weight perturbations, and has a clean bipartiteness threshold. It supplies the entire support function, not just isolated numerical values, and a sharp discontinuity on adding an odd cycle. It is a motivated, complete answer for a large operator family, beyond the general existence and hull criteria of the defining 2023 paper.
